subject: Initial supplier onboarding: payment path & QuickPay option
messages:
From: Maya Johnson <maya@payflow.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts@payflow.io
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding & QuickPay inquiry

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier — excited to get PayFlow set up in Redwood's vendor system. Attached are our completed vendor onboarding form and W-9 (payflow_vendor_form.pdf, payflow_w9.pdf). A couple items we want to confirm up front so invoices don't get delayed: 

- Preferred PO fields: do you need a specific PO-level custom field for project codes?
- Net terms: you typically default to Net 30, correct? We often request a QuickPay option (Net 7 with a small discount) for the first month while account is being established.
- Remittance: we prefer ACH; can you send a secure link for banking info?

If possible, we'd like to propose QuickPay at a 1.25% discount for invoice settlement within 7 days for the first two invoices while our account is confirmed. Open to whichever process makes sense on your side — happy to take next steps.

Best,
Maya Johnson
Head of Finance Operations
PayFlow Inc.
Attachments: payflow_vendor_form.pdf, payflow_w9.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Johnson <maya@payflow.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding & QuickPay inquiry

Hi Maya — thanks for sending these over and for the clear ask. Looping in Karthik (procurement) and Marissa (billing) so we can confirm. Quick answers: 

- PO fields: We can add a free-text project_code field on PO 4527; please include that in the invoice's PO line.
- Default Net terms: Redwood standard is Net 30 for new vendors; we evaluate early-pay pilots on a case-by-case basis.
- Secure remittance: we'll send a secure bank intake link via our payments portal once the vendor form is accepted.

Karthik / Marissa — PayFlow is requesting an early settlement pilot for first two invoices (Net 7 @ 1.25% discount). Can procurement sign-off on PO-level fields and do we have any constraints with single-invoice QuickPay pilots for newly onboarded vendors? Also flagging for Ben to confirm ACH intake process.

Maya — I will confirm next steps by EOB tomorrow.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding & QuickPay inquiry

Grace / Marissa — on procurement side this is fine to proceed with conditions: 

- Add project_code free-text to PO 4527 (procurement will validate mapping to GL).
- QuickPay pilot approval: agree to trial for first two invoices at 1.25% discount, provided vendor completes bank verification via our secure link and accepts a one-time test $0.01 micro-deposit to confirm ACH.
- We need vendor to sign the PO electronically (DocuSign link); procurement will not route payment until signature and bank verification are complete.

If billing is okay with the discount approach, procurement can mark PO 4527 with the flag "QUICKPAY-PILOT" and close the loop.

Karthik
Director, Procurement
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding & QuickPay inquiry

Thanks — billing is comfortable with the pilot under these guardrails: 

- Net 30 remains default. For QuickPay we will apply a 1.25% early-settlement discount on cleared invoices; final payout will show as invoice_total minus discount.
- We will not enable settlement until the vendor signs the PO and completes ACH validation. Ben, need you to prepare the secure bank intake and the micro-deposit workflow.

Grace / Karthik — flagging that the vendor will need to accept the DocuSign PO and follow the banklink. Once those are complete, accounting will enable the QuickPay flag for the first two invoices.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Johnson <maya@payflow.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, accounts@payflow.io
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirming onboarding path & QuickPay pilot (PO 4527)

Hi Maya — quick update and next steps so there’s no ambiguity: 

1) Procurement has approved PO 4527 with an added project_code field. We will attach PO_4527 to your vendor record and send it via DocuSign for signature. Link: https://redwood.app/sign/PO-4527

2) Accounting will keep Redwood default at Net 30. However, we've approved a QuickPay pilot for your first two invoices at a 1.25% early-settlement discount if invoices are paid within 7 days. This will be applied as soon as we confirm: (a) signed PO, (b) completed bank verification (secure link below), and (c) a successful micro-deposit test.

3) Secure bank intake: Please use this link to submit ACH details (PayFlow bank info will be encrypted in transit). https://secure.redwood.ai/banklink/payflow-4527

4) Attachments: we received payflow_vendor_form.pdf and payflow_w9.pdf. Please confirm if the legal name on invoices matches the W-9 as listed.

If you approve, we will: (1) send DocuSign PO, (2) enable bank intake, (3) validate micro-deposit, (4) enable QuickPay flag for first two invoices. Otherwise, default will remain Net 30.

Thanks — looking forward to having PayFlow live.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
